Definition: properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear
BiblicalUsage: 1) to long for, yearn for, long after; 1a) (Qal) to long for; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to long for (deeply); 1b2) being longed for (participle)
